purpose: P0-Q biological observability and identifiability qualification of the complete frozen six-state Jaruszewicz-Blonska NF-kB local generator before any chi_bio admission

primary_observable.name: free nuclear NF-kappaB
primary_observable.basis: publication-native plotted biological output established before this gate

jacobian_rule.equilibrium_source: immutable accepted root from local-stability v0.3 artifact
jacobian_rule.recomputation: recompute the native six-state Jacobian from the pinned reduced equations at the immutable equilibrium

full_state_rank.pass_rule: rank(O) = 6 at all three frozen Jacobian step multipliers

mode_output_visibility.definition: |C v_j| / ||v_j||_2 for every right eigenvector v_j
mode_output_visibility.role: descriptive identifiability evidence only; no mode may be selected by largest visibility

complex_pair_consistency.rule: the already-identified unique nonreal conjugate pair must remain the same conjugate eigenspace across the three frozen numerical Jacobians

adjudication.PASS_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY: full six-state local generator is observable through the publication-native nuclear NF-kB output under the frozen rank rule at every Jacobian step
adjudication.REFUSE_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY: rank deficiency occurs under at least one frozen Jacobian step
adjudication.INDETERMINATE_NUMERICAL: SVD/rank result is numerically inconsistent across frozen steps or nonfinite

next_if_pass: freeze and execute a separate same-mode scalar trajectory qualification rule on source-native pulse protocols without changing the candidate mode or observable
next_if_fail: retain Chi_bio as generator-level precursor only and refuse nuclear-NF-kB-based chi_bio qualification for this route
